summary: BLM lookout on a Lassen County summit of 7,964 to 7,970 ft; the register says staffed as of 2015, while Peakbagging describes it as abandoned for some years.

facts.status_note: Sources disagree on whether it is still staffed; one describes it as abandoned.

corrections.why: The register says the lookout was built sometime in the 1960s, according to a 1986 survey. It gives no single year.

notes_for_editor: Staffing conflict: the register says staffed in fire season as of 2015, while Peakbagging (photo dated November 2007) says abandoned for some years. Undated, so the newer source is unknown. Elevation conflict: the register gives 7,970 ft (2,429 m), Peakbagging 7968 ft, and the tipurdy page 7964 ft; the story gives all three. No access, visit or structure height data found, so those keys are omitted. A Wikimapia page returned no text when fetched and is not used. The record's built year 1960 is only the 1960s decade.
